name: U.S. collar / lapel insignia, metal (officers; adults without grade who will become officers)
size_basis: No dimension in CAPR 39-1; DAFI 36-2903 shows the same 5/8-1 in US lapel insignia. Letter height 0.40 in, width 1.05 in, proportioned like the CAP letters of Fig A6-5
provenance: in-house block letters U . S . (CAPR 39-1 Fig A6-5)

mounts.uniform: Class A / service coat, officers and adults without grade who will become officers
mounts.rule: on each lapel halfway up the seam, resting on but not over it; letters parallel with the ground; no circle for officers (4.1.5.2.2.1.1, 4.1.9.4.1.1)
